before.title: Brake Rotor Warping and Premature Front Brake Wear
before.description: Owners frequently report front brake pulsation and rapid pad/rotor wear on the FX45, especially with aggressive driving or heavy wheel/tire setups. The heavy V8 crossover places high thermal load on the front brakes, and lower-quality replacement rotors tend to develop thickness variation quickly.
before.solution: Diagnosis includes measuring rotor thickness variation, checking pad wear, and inspecting caliper slide movement. Repair typically involves replacing front rotors and pads together, cleaning/lubricating slide pins, and checking for sticking calipers or hub runout; premium coated rotors and quality ceramic pads usually last longer. Typical cost is about $350 to $900 for a proper front brake service.

citations.title: NHTSA complaints involving brake vibration and rotor wear on Infiniti FX models

communityRecommendations.content: Owners often recommend premium coated rotors to reduce repeat pulsation and corrosion compared with economy rotors.
Quality ceramic pads are commonly suggested for better dust control and smoother braking.
Torque lug nuts evenly with a torque wrench after wheel service, since uneven torque can contribute to brake vibration complaints.

before.title: Camshaft and Crankshaft Position Sensor Failure
before.description: Camshaft and crankshaft position sensors are a well-known failure point on many Nissan and Infiniti vehicles of this era, including the FX45. Heat and age can cause intermittent signal loss, resulting in stalling, hard starting, limp operation, or a no-start condition.
before.solution: Diagnosis is done by scanning for cam/crank correlation or sensor circuit faults and monitoring RPM/cam signals during cranking. Repair usually involves replacing the failed camshaft sensor(s) and/or crankshaft sensor with quality OEM-equivalent parts and clearing codes; access is generally straightforward compared with internal engine work. Typical repair cost is about $180 to $500 depending on how many sensors are replaced.

citations.title: NHTSA complaints for Infiniti FX45 involving stalling and cam/crank sensor faults

communityRecommendations.content: Owners strongly prefer OEM-supplier sensors because cheap aftermarket units are often reported to fail quickly or trigger repeat codes.
Replacing the crank sensor at the same time is common preventive maintenance when one timing sensor fails.
If the vehicle stalls hot and restarts after cooling down, check sensor data before replacing fuel system parts.

before.title: Front Suspension Control Arm and Bushing Wear
before.description: The FX45 is known for front suspension wear, especially in the upper and lower control arm bushings and ball joints. The vehicle's weight, wheel/tire package, and sporty suspension tuning contribute to clunks, looseness, and uneven tire wear as the bushings deteriorate.
before.solution: Diagnosis involves checking for play in the front suspension, inspecting cracked bushings, and verifying alignment angles and tire wear patterns. Repair typically includes replacing the worn control arm assemblies rather than pressing bushings individually, followed by a four-wheel alignment. Typical cost ranges from $500 to $1,400 depending on how many arms and links are replaced.

citations.title: NHTSA complaints involving front suspension noise and control arm wear on Infiniti FX models

communityRecommendations.content: Owners frequently recommend complete arm assemblies because they save labor and include fresh bushings and joints.
Have alignment checked immediately after replacing any front suspension arm, or the new tires can wear quickly.
Sway bar end links are often replaced at the same time if clunking persists over small bumps.

before.title: Fuel Level Sending Unit Failure
before.description: The FX45 can develop inaccurate fuel gauge readings due to wear or contamination in the fuel level sending unit. This may cause the gauge to stick, read empty when fuel remains, or trigger low-fuel warnings inconsistently, which is a known Nissan/Infiniti issue from this era.
before.solution: Diagnosis involves comparing scan tool fuel level data with actual tank fill amount and checking sender resistance through the fuel pump module circuit. Repair usually requires replacing the faulty fuel level sender or pump module assembly, depending on parts availability and condition of the rest of the unit. Typical cost is about $300 to $800 including labor.
symptoms: Low fuel light comes on too early

citations.title: NHTSA complaints involving inaccurate fuel gauge readings on Infiniti FX vehicles

communityRecommendations.content: Owners often replace the full module when access is open, especially on higher-mileage vehicles, to avoid repeating labor.
Until repaired, track mileage between fill-ups rather than trusting the gauge if it becomes erratic.
If the tank is already being opened for sender work, inspect the pump strainer and electrical connector for heat damage.

before.title: Radiator Failure Causing Overheating
before.description: A common aging issue on the FX45 is radiator tank cracking or seam leakage, especially on higher-mileage vehicles exposed to heat cycling. Coolant loss can lead to overheating, and if ignored, the VK45DE can suffer head gasket damage or warped components.
before.solution: Diagnosis includes pressure-testing the cooling system, checking for leaks at the radiator end tanks, and inspecting hoses, cap, and thermostat operation. Repair usually means replacing the radiator assembly and fresh coolant, with many owners also replacing upper/lower hoses and the thermostat at the same time. Typical total cost is about $450 to $950 depending on parts quality and labor rates.
symptoms: Coolant smell from front of vehicle
Visible coolant leak under radiator area
Low coolant level warning or repeated top-offs

citations.title: NHTSA complaints for Infiniti FX45 involving overheating and radiator leaks

communityRecommendations.content: Owners often choose a replacement radiator from a known aftermarket supplier rather than waiting for the original plastic tanks to fail again.
Replace the radiator cap and inspect both cooling fans whenever overheating starts, because weak cap pressure and fan issues can mimic radiator failure.
Many owners replace aging coolant hoses during radiator service to prevent follow-up leaks.

before.title: Timing Chain Guide Wear and Chain Noise
before.description: The VK45DE V8 used in the FX45 can develop timing chain guide and tensioner wear, leading to chain rattle on startup or at idle. Owners report the issue more often on higher-mileage engines or vehicles with poor oil change history, where sludge and low oil pressure accelerate guide and tensioner wear.
before.solution: Diagnosis usually starts with confirming front cover chain noise during cold start and checking oil condition, oil pressure, and cam/crank correlation data. Repair typically involves replacing timing chain guides, tensioners, and often the primary chain while the front timing cover is removed; parts and labor are substantial because of the engine teardown. Typical repair cost runs about $1,800 to $3,500 depending on how many timing components are replaced.

citations.title: NHTSA complaints mentioning timing chain/engine noise on Infiniti FX45

communityRecommendations.content: Use high-quality synthetic oil and avoid extended oil change intervals, since dirty oil is commonly blamed for accelerating chain guide and tensioner wear.
Owners commonly recommend replacing the water pump belt and front seals while the timing cover is apart to avoid duplicate labor later.
If startup rattle lasts more than a second or becomes frequent, inspect it early before chain slack causes cam timing faults.
